title: Institutional ICT supply and deployment
summary: Procurement, installation, configuration and end-to-end support of ICT equipment and software for public institutions and development organisations across Zambia.

specs.label: Equipment
specs.value: Computers, printers, networking, servers, UPS, software and digital security readers

specs.label: Channels
